title.rendered: Kinder Virtual Open House Info – April 28th

content.rendered:
This year we will be hosting a virtual Kindergarten Parent Information night. During this zoom meeting you will be able to meet the kindergarten teachers, learn more about the kindergarten program and ask any questions you may have.

Please click HERE at 6 pm on April 28th at 6:00 pm to join our Kindergarten Virtual Open House.
